days.dateLabel: Day 1: West Delhi Comforts & South Delhi Heritage

activities.title: Starbucks, Janakpuri District Center
activities.description: Enjoy a familiar, premium breakfast with freshly brewed coffee and warm wraps in a cozy setting.
activities.preferenceReasoning: Located just a 2-minute walk from your hotel lobby, making it the perfect, hassle-free morning start.

activities.title: Qutub Minar Complex
activities.description: Explore the world's tallest brick minaret, surrounded by ancient ruins of incredible historical significance.
activities.preferenceReasoning: An iconic Delhi landmark that offers stunning architectural photography and rich medieval history.

activities.title: Barbeque Nation, Janakpuri
activities.description: Feast on an unlimited, live-grill buffet featuring a delicious variety of vegetarian and meat skewers.
activities.preferenceReasoning: A legendary dining experience situated a mere 3-minute walk from the Hyatt Centric.

activities.title: Chaayos, Janakpuri District Center
activities.description: Sip customizable, aromatic Indian street chai paired with classic breakfast snacks like bun maska.
activities.preferenceReasoning: A highly-rated local tea cafe located just a 2-minute walk from the hotel.

activities.title: Humayun's Tomb
activities.description: Admire the spectacular precursor to the Taj Mahal, set within beautifully manicured Mughal charbagh gardens.
activities.preferenceReasoning: A UNESCO World Heritage site that showcases the peak of early Mughal architecture.

activities.title: Bercos, Janakpuri
activities.description: Dine on Delhi's favorite comforting Indo-Chinese dishes in a vibrant, family-friendly setting.
activities.preferenceReasoning: A legendary local brand serving hot, flavorful meals just a 3-minute walk from your room.

activities.title: Sagar Ratna, Janakpuri
activities.description: Enjoy authentic, piping hot South Indian delicacies like crispy dosas and fluffy idlis.
activities.preferenceReasoning: A clean, highly popular South Indian spot located only a 4-minute walk from your hotel.

activities.title: Swaminarayan Akshardham
activities.description: Witness a colossal pink stone temple complex celebrating India's ancient art, culture, and spirituality.
activities.preferenceReasoning: An awe-inspiring modern marvel easily reachable via the direct Blue Line metro from Janakpuri West.

activities.title: Kitchen District at Hyatt Centric
activities.description: Indulge in a luxurious, multi-cuisine dinner buffet featuring local Delhi delicacies and international classics.
activities.preferenceReasoning: Conclude your trip with a premium dining experience located directly inside your hotel building, eliminating any late-night travel.

itinerary_data.tagline: Historic Wonders & Modern Comforts from Janakpuri
